title: Frontend: Anagram Checker
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Anagram Checker. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution([a,b]). Normalize to lowercase ASCII letters/digits and compare character multiplicities; ignore other characters.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Normalize both strings consistently and compare frequency maps, decrementing counts as the second string is scanned.
alternativeApproaches: Compare normalized canonical equivalents without accidentally discarding meaningful language distinctions.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Repeated letters; unequal lengths; mixed case.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
